sub_sector.value: cane sugar refining; sweetener supply chain and warehousing services

product_category.detail: Refined cane sugar, organic sugar and specialty sweeteners sold as ingredients to food manufacturers.

market_position.detail: Alternative integrated cane sugar refiner supplying industrial customers with conventional cane, organic and specialty sweeteners.

distribution_model.detail: Sells bulk and specialty sugar directly to food and beverage manufacturers, with supply, warehousing and freight services.

purchase_frequency.detail: Sugar is a staple ingredient bought continually by food and beverage manufacturers.

notes: Business-to-business sugar refiner; consumer-facing facets are inferred loosely, and the distribution category fits imperfectly since customers are manufacturers, not retailers.
